in_marathi.name: Rohanesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे The Lord of Light
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rohanesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rohanesh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'rohana' and 'ish', meaning 'light' and 'god' respectively. Rohanesh signifies the god of light, representing brightness, wisdom, and positivity.
